policies.name: Trainers can view own course bookings
policies.using: (EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM courses c WHERE ((c.id = bookings.course_id) AND (c.instructor_id = @trainer_id))))

policies.name: Trainers can manage own templates
policies.using: ((instructor_id IS NOT NULL) AND (@trainer_id IS NOT NULL) AND (instructor_id = @trainer_id))
policies.check: ((instructor_id IS NOT NULL) AND (@trainer_id IS NOT NULL) AND (instructor_id = @trainer_id))

policies.name: Users can view courses they booked
policies.using: EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM bookings _b WHERE _b.user_id = @uid AND _b.course_id = courses.id)

policies.name: Users can view items of own orders
policies.using: (EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM orders o WHERE ((o.id = order_items.order_id) AND (o.user_id = @uid))))

policies.name: Users can insert items into own orders
policies.check: (EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM orders o WHERE ((o.id = order_items.order_id) AND (o.user_id = @uid))))

policies.name: Staff can view all order items
Trainers can view profiles of their bookings
policies.using: (EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM (bookings b JOIN courses c ON ((c.id = b.course_id))) WHERE ((b.user_id = profiles.user_id) AND (c.instructor_id = @trainer_id))))

policies.name: Public can read published video courses
Users with active access can view lessons
policies.using: ((is_free_preview = true) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM video_course_access _a WHERE _a.user_id = @uid AND _a.course_id = video_lessons.course_id AND (_a.status = 'active' OR (_a.status = 'grace' AND _a.grace_until IS NOT NULL AND _a.grace_until > @now) OR (_a.status = 'cancelled' AND _a.current_period_end IS NOT NULL AND _a.current_period_end > @now))))

public_trainers.sql: SELECT id, first_name, last_name FROM trainers WHERE is_active = 1

video_lessons_public.sql: SELECT l.id, l.course_id, l.title, l.description, l.provider, l.duration_seconds, l.sort_order, l.is_free_preview, l.created_at FROM video_lessons l JOIN video_courses c ON c.id = l.course_id WHERE c.is_published = 1 OR @role_admin = 1

storagePolicies.name: Admins and trainers can upload course images
Admins and trainers can update course images
Trainers read own payout files
storagePolicies.using: ((bucket_id = 'trainer-payouts') AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM trainer_payouts p WHERE ((p.pdf_path = objects.name) AND (p.trainer_id = @trainer_id)))))

storagePolicies.name: Users can read own invoices
storagePolicies.using: ((bucket_id = 'invoices') AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM orders o WHERE ((o.invoice_pdf_path = objects.name) AND (o.user_id = @uid)))))
